title: Origami EPUB Profile 1.0 — the semantic record (Visual-Meta)
description: Schema for the record declared with properties="origami:visual-meta". Authoritative for concepts, citations, structure, endnotes, cross-document relationships and lineage. See profile §8. The forbidden-members rule of §9.0 is enforced structurally at the end of this schema: tables, map and models belong to the interaction record and a record carrying them is rejected here rather than by a validator's own walk.

visual-meta.description: Self-identification (§8.1). A record extracted from its publication must still say what it is, what version it is, and what it describes.

introduction.description: A human-readable sentence explaining Visual-Meta. Permitted, but it is not a substitute for the rendered colophon of §7.4, which lives in the content where a person can see it.

document.description: Document-level identity (§8.2). Derived from the package, which remains authoritative (§11.3).

release.description: The human-meaningful release label, mirroring the package's schema:version (§4.3). A string or a number; never an identifier.

modified.description: The release timestamp, mirroring dcterms:modified (§4.3). The package governs (§11.4).

hasVersion.description: FORBIDDEN as a revision label. DCMI defines dcterms:hasVersion as a relation to another resource, not a literal (§4.3.1). Use `release`.

defaultDocument.description: The content document against which bare-fragment references in this record resolve (§5.1, §8.2). A record that omits this must use full path#fragment addresses everywhere.

digest.description: FORBIDDEN. 1.0 defines no text fingerprint (§12.2). A pre-1.0 digest was unreproducible and unread; a field inviting confidence in integrity while being unverifiable is worse than no field.

structure.description: Navigation index (§8.2). Derived from the content documents, which govern (§11.3).

address.description: An optional human-meaningful positional address such as "2B". Informative only: it renumbers when the document is edited, so it MUST NOT be used as an identity (§5.2).

concepts.description: Glossary entries and the relationships between them (§8.3). The XHTML glossary governs the term and definition a reader displays (§11.3).

citations.description: Where citations sit and what they point at (§8.4). The bibliographic record itself is canonical in the bibliography record (§10) and MUST NOT be duplicated here — see the bibtex/csl prohibitions below.

bibtex.description: FORBIDDEN. references.bib is canonical (§10, §11.3). A BibTeX string here is a second copy with no declared authority.

csl.description: FORBIDDEN here. CSL JSON may be emitted as a separate, clearly-marked derived record with properties="origami:bibliography-csl" (§10).

footnotes.description: Inline notes, same shape as endnotes (§8.7).

links.description: Cross-document relationships (§8.5). toEdition and toAddress are required: an action URI alone is not a representation a reader without the scheme can follow (§6.11).

lineage.description: Claims about which elements replaced which (§8.6). A claim, not a fact (§5.4).

equations.description: The equation index (§6.7.1, §8.8). OPTIONAL, and derived: MathML in the body is authoritative, so a failed checksum means the body governs (§11.3, §11.4). This is the index's only home in a conforming publication — the pre-1.0 delimited text block inside a content document is not discoverable by any package mechanism and is forbidden (§6.7.2).

comments.description: The writer's own published annotations. NOT reader annotations, which never appear in a publication (§14).

custom.description: Implementation-specific extras. A reader MUST ignore what it does not understand (§15.3).

tables.description: FORBIDDEN in this record. Tables belong to the interaction record (§9.2, §9.0).

map.description: FORBIDDEN in this record. Authored layouts belong to the interaction record (§9.3, §9.0).

models.description: FORBIDDEN in this record. The 3D model index belongs to the interaction record (§9.5, §9.0).

recordVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR of the record format itself.

publicationIdentifier.description: An edition or work identifier. urn:uuid is required for a work (§4.3); urn:isbn and DOI forms are accepted for an edition.

elementIdentifier.description: An XHTML id as published. Never rewritten, and case-sensitive (§5.2). No prefix is required: software MUST NOT infer semantics from an id prefix.

address.description: The canonical address of an element: a content-resource path relative to the package document, plus a fragment (§5.1). A bare fragment is permitted only where the record declares document.defaultDocument (§8.2).
